purpose: Dallas Gamecast integration closure contract: end-to-end readiness, deterministic fail-safe behavior and handoff into final team QA without changing shared MLB/NHL runtime.

productionReadiness.eligibility: A Dallas chibi may render only when stable DAL player identity, roster-authoritative action eligibility and a release-gated asset all resolve for the same season snapshot.
productionReadiness.eventAuthority: Authoritative Gamecast play truth owns player role, action, football possession and correction state; polling cadence and file presence cannot manufacture events.
productionReadiness.identityAuthority: Appearance remains locked to the player's current official Dallas headshot reference and current roster number; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name.
productionReadiness.assetFailure: Any unresolved, corrupt, stale or ineligible chibi asset degrades to the existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation without guessing another player or appearance.
productionReadiness.signatureAuthority: Only verified signature concepts on the Dallas allowlist may render, once per authoritative event key, and they remain interruptible by newer or corrected play truth.
productionReadiness.namespace: All caches, event keys, asset paths and state are scoped NFL/DAL so Dallas integration cannot mutate MLB or NHL behavior.

endToEndInvariants.footAnchor: bottom-center between planted feet; no accumulated root-motion drift across sequences
endToEndInvariants.football: exactly one visual football authority at any instant
endToEndInvariants.timeline: one monotonic play-scoped clock; polling arrival time never drives animation progress
endToEndInvariants.participantLimit: respect the bounded Gamecast chibi scene participant policy and retain existing Gamecast for overflow
endToEndInvariants.accessibility: reduced-motion mode preserves event meaning and identity while suppressing nonessential flourish

requiredEvidence: roster.json resolves all 53 Dallas player identities and authoritative action inventories
all 53 appearance-reference locks remain tied to official headshot evidence rather than name inference
all 53 base-chibi specifications preserve canonical visual invariants
all 53 players have position-appropriate action-pose specifications
the two verified Dallas signature sequences remain allowlisted and no invented named signature exists
all ten Gamecast integration contracts remain internally compatible
missing/corrupt/stale assets always preserve existing non-chibi Gamecast
no Dallas integration contract introduces MLB/NHL mutation or dependency
qaHandoff.completionRule: Dallas must not advance to PHI until final QA explicitly passes the complete Dallas asset/integration inventory.

checks: Production eligibility requires matching Dallas identity, roster action inventory and release-gated asset.
Official-headshot appearance locks, current numbers and approved realistic 3D style remain invariant.
Foot anchors, camera, lighting, scale and transparent alpha remain consistent across end-to-end sequences.
Football ownership remains singular through actions, handoffs, corrections and failures.
Repeated polling cannot replay actions or verified signatures.
Unverified named celebrations cannot enter production routing.
All failure modes retain the existing non-chibi Gamecast rather than guessing identity or appearance.
Dallas state remains isolated from MLB/NHL runtime and metadata.
Final Dallas QA is the only permitted gate before moving to Philadelphia roster-scaffold work.
